observations: A three-wheeled mobility scooter with a padded seat and armrests, shown outdoors on dirt ground.
Front basket attached, tiller/handlebar with controls visible, blue and gray plastic body panels.
No brand, model, or serial number plate is readable anywhere in the photo.
A faint watermark reading something like a shop/technology name appears on the image, but it is a seller overlay, not an item label.
No charger, battery compartment, or power-on display is visible.
Background shows a rough dirt yard with a fence/building, consistent with an informal resale setting, not a showroom.

claims.evidence: No import documents, labels, or markings visible in photo 0 to confirm origin.
No video or photo showing it powered on, moving, or charging; condition of battery/motor cannot be judged from a static photo.

risks.risk: Battery may be dead or near end-of-life, common in used mobility scooters.
risks.proof: A clip showing the scooter powering on and driving a short distance, plus a photo of the battery charge indicator.
risks.if_unproven: priced as not working / battery needing replacement

risks.risk: Motor or controller fault not visible in a still photo.
risks.proof: A video of the scooter moving forward, reversing, and braking.

risks.risk: Tires may be flat, cracked, or non-pneumatic foam that is degraded.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of all three tires and tread.

risks.risk: Seat, upholstery, or frame may have hidden rust/cracks from outdoor storage.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of frame joints, underside, and seat padding.

risks.risk: Charger may be missing or incompatible, which is often sold separately for used units.
risks.proof: Photo of the charger unit and its label/voltage.

proof_requests: Video of the scooter being switched on and driven a short distance, including braking.
Close-up photo of any brand/model/serial plate, often under the seat or on the tiller.
Photo of the battery compartment and charger with visible label.
Close-up photos of all three tires and the frame underside for rust/cracks.
response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable as a three-wheeled mobility scooter by type, but with no proof of power-on function, battery health, or tire condition, it must be priced at worst case as a non-working unit until further evidence is provided.
